name: app-flow-live-data-and-route-planning-screens-with-notes
title: Flow cycling app: live performance data and personalised route-planning screens on light grey cards
whatItIs: Two phones on light grey cards: 'Canlı Veri' (Live Data) listing speed, heart rate, cadence, altitude and power each with a mini sparkline, and 'Rota Planlama' (Route Planning) with from/to fields and stacked route-option cards (Fastest, Scenic, Safest) with a 'Create Route' button, each with a rationale caption below.
whatItMeans: Data-rich yet calm; sparklines and named route personalities make dense metrics feel approachable.
techniques: Pair each metric with a small sparkline trend.
Offer named route personalities instead of raw options.
Set data screens on light cards for a calmer read than the dark tracking view.

vocabulary.definition: A small trend-line chart with no axes.
A named route type reflecting a different priority.
